metadata.scenario: A new prospect calls to ask about the pricing and availability of pet sitting services. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Agnes Rodriguez. I’m looking for pet sitting services, do you offer that? I’m sorry, Agnes, but we actually do not provide pet sitting services. Oh, I see. That’s too bad. I really need someone for my dog. I understand; caring for pets is important. We primarily focus on healthcare services. Right, I've heard you offer companion care. Can you tell me more about that? Absolutely! Our companion care services offer social interaction, light housekeeping, and personal assistance. That sounds useful. What’s the pricing for that service? The price ranges from $25 to $30 per hour, depending on the level of care required. That’s reasonable. I’m actually a regular client for companion care. Oh, I see! Thank you for being a loyal client, Agnes. How can we assist you further today? I was wondering if you could add some garden activities to my care plan? That sounds like a wonderful idea! I can definitely arrange that for you. Great! I love gardening, and it would help with my social isolation. Absolutely, it’s important to have those activities to engage you. Will my caregiver be able to assist with that? Yes, your caregiver can help with gardening activities during your scheduled visits. Perfect! What about medication management? Is that included as well? Medication management is a separate service, priced between $65 and $80 for 30 to 45 minutes. I see. I might need that service too, but I’ll think about it. Of course! Just let us know when you’re ready to discuss that further. Thank you! I appreciate all the help you provide. It’s our pleasure, Agnes. Would you like me to schedule a follow-up call about the gardening activities? Yes, that would be great! Can we set it for next week? Sure! I’ll have Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, give you a call on Monday. Sounds good. Thank you so much for your assistance! You’re very welcome! Have a wonderful day, Agnes. You too, bye! Goodbye!
